description: This source file contains the implementation of the generic class `StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>` that manages stream subscription handles within the Orleans streaming framework. It provides methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, resuming, delivering batches, and processing individual items in a stream, with support for rewindable streams and serialization.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>
classes.description: A class that manages a subscription handle for a stream, supporting operations like unsubscribe, resume, and delivering data items or batches, with support for serialization and internal validation.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the handle by clearing internal references, marking it as no longer valid.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns the expected handshake token for the stream, used for ordered delivery.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (observer)
methods.description: Resumes the subscription with a new observer.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (batchObserver)
methods.description: Resumes the subscription with a new batch observer.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Processes and delivers a batch of data items to the observer, with optional handshake token validation.

methods.name: DeliverItem
methods.description: Processes and delivers a single data item to the observer, with optional handshake token validation.

methods.name: NextBatch
methods.description: Processes and delivers a batch of containers to the observer.

methods.name: NextItem
methods.description: Delivers a single item to the observer if valid.

methods.name: NextItems
methods.description: Delivers multiple items as a batch to the observer.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error occurred in the stream to the observer.

methods.name: SameStreamId
methods.description: Checks whether the given stream ID matches the stream this handle is associated with.

methods.name: Equals (StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>)
methods.description: Checks equality based on the subscription ID.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the subscription ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the subscription handle.
